text: The method is applied by the engines of the project (progress_report, engineering_plan, release_control, schedule) on the data in the database; no progress figure is typed into a report by hand. This procedure is consistent with section 10 of ALP-EPC-00000-GE-PRC-0002 (release control and process gates) and with ALP-EPC-00000-GE-PLN-0001 (engineering execution plan).
